description: This pie chart illustrates four core components or properties, divided into four equal slices. The top-left slice is yellow, representing approximately 25% of the chart, and features the internal label "Complexity" alongside a ladder icon, with an external boxed label reading "Uncrushable." The top-right slice is blue-grey, also accounting for 25%, labeled internally as "Instance" with a shield and checkmark icon, and externally as "Unhackable." The bottom-left slice is reddish-brown, making up 25%, labeled "Scalable Oversight" internally with a clipboard and checkmark icon, and "Auto-verifiable" externally. The bottom-right slice is green, comprising the final 25%, labeled "Coverage" internally with a globe and gear icon, and "General" externally. The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit percentage labels, relying instead on direct text labels and icons both inside and outside the segments. Additionally, the four slices are visually separated by a thin, cross-shaped gap, and because they are equal in size, there is no descending or ascending order to their arrangement.
